title: Colossi of Memnon
aliases: Statues of Amenhotep III at Kom el-Hettan
summary: The Colossi of Memnon are two seated statues of Amenhotep III that flank the entrance to his mortuary temple on the west bank at Luxor, Egypt. The University of Memphis dates the king to c. 1390-1353 BCE and gives the statues as about 19.6 m high; an earthquake damaged them.

uncertainty.note: Dated by the reign of Amenhotep III, c. 1390-1353 BCE; neither page opened gives a carving date for the statues.
